title: docs(skills): the D11 close refuses only a declared-override move; an added email-template locale keeps its package-less write

Model: the `skills/**` tier mandate (dispatch clause ①) is waived by the maintainer while that tier's quota is exhausted; developed one tier below it; contract review by triage. The ruling, verbatim:

> 你的任务继续处理，没有fable可以用 opus，等契约复审

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:objectstack-platform 技能里 ADR-0146 定制段的 D11 那句话改正:只有迁移仪式会「以声明 override 的方式」搬走的旧 Setup 行,搬前搬后才拒绝不带包的保存、发布、重置和回滚;基础包没发运的邮件模板语言(仪式把它当配对包自己的成员搬,`addedMember`)保留这个写入口。另删掉一段重复的「CLI Commands」指针小节付 token 账,并加一份 `@objectstack/skills` 的 patch changeset(技能随该包发布)。
- 为什么改:PR #29258 之后迁移仪式会把这种语言行当配对包自有成员搬走,而 D11 关门(`packagelessCloseSubject`)只判声明 override 的搬法;技能原句说「一律拒绝」,对这种行是错的,AI 照着写会以为这类写入已被关。ADR-0087 条目那一半已由 PR #29457 改正,这里是剩下的一份。
- 风险与回滚:纯技能文本加一份 changeset,无代码、无契约改动。token 上限行未动(6011/6011),无 re-wrap;被删的指针小节在同文件 Part 3 指针里有家。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` 第 132 行定制段里 `(D11)` 前后那半句;同文件被删的 `## CLI Commands` 小节;`.changeset/29461-d11-added-locale-keeps-write.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期 `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md is 6011 tokens (ceiling 6011; headroom 0)`,全绿。
- 需要你做的:Tier H 受管面(`skills/**`),需要 `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` 的批准;PR 保持 draft,等分诊对第二轮的增量契约复审。

## What changes

Facts are taken from the merged code on `main` (a04e9d76), not the card alone: `packagelessCloseSubject` and `classifyPackagelessRow` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts`, the ceremony's `addedMemberOf` and its `moved` + `addedMember` outcome in the same file, and the corrected ADR-0087 entry `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.packageless-overlay-write-closed.ts` (PR #29457).

1. **`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`, the ADR-0146 customization paragraph (L132).** The D11 clause read "its package-less save, reset and rollback are refused once movable (D11)". It now reads: "once movable as a declared override, its package-less save, publish, reset and rollback are refused (D11); an email-template row at a locale the base does not ship moves as the pair's own member and keeps that write." The four operations are `PackagelessWriteOperation` (`save | publish | delete | rollback`, `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`); the old clause left out publish. That is what `packagelessCloseSubject` does: it closes a package-less write only where the census answers `movable` AND `overlayPairFixAdmits` admits the declared body into the pair; an `email_template` member at a locale the base does not ship is refused by that gate, so the close leaves it open, while the ceremony moves the row as the pair's own member (`addedMember`, no `overrides`). The rest of the paragraph is byte-identical.
2. **Payment, same file.** The `## CLI Commands` section (a heading, one pointer line and its `---` rule; 140 bytes) is cut. Its home: the Part 3 pointer further down the same file, which links the same `references/operations.md` and names its "Daily-loop commands" section first. No other file links the cut heading's anchor (`git grep '#cli-commands'` over `skills/`, `content/docs/`, `scripts/`: zero hits).
3. **`.changeset/29461-d11-added-locale-keeps-write.md`.** `'@objectstack/skills': patch` with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`: `skills/**` ships in `@objectstack/skills`, so a skills change takes route 1 of Check Changeset (`.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml`), never the `skip-changeset` label.

### Token ratchet, paid in place (no ceiling row moved, no re-wrap)

| file | tokens before / after / ceiling | bytes before / after | lines before / after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` | 6011 / 6011 / 6011 | 24061 / 24064 | 435 / 429 |
| package `skills/objectstack-platform` (all files) | — | — | 2238 / 2232 |
| every `skills/*/SKILL.md` together | — | — | 4543 / 4537 |

The D11 clause grows by 143 bytes and the cut removes 140; the file's priced text was 3 bytes under the 6011 ceiling and is exactly at it now (24044 priced bytes, 6011 tokens).

### Evals

`skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` has two cases on this paragraph. Case 10 (replace a HotCRM view) says a package-unbound Setup row "wins only until the D11 migration": a view is a declared-override move, so it stays true and is unchanged. Case 11 (a dependent package's override) does not touch D11. No case covers an added email-template locale; none is added here (see Acceptance notes).

## Why

Since PR #29258 (#28904) `os migrate packageless-overlays` moves a package-less row of an `email_template` locale the base does not ship as the pair's own member, declaring nothing, and the D11 close judges only the declared-override move, so that row's package-less write stays open before and after the move. The skill said every movable row loses it. PR #29457 (#29261) corrected the same claim in the ADR-0087 entry; this was the remaining copy.

## Acceptance notes

- The edit is made on the branch the platform fixes for this thread (`claude/project-thread-x5gki7`) in this container's own checkout rather than a sibling worktree: the container is this card's alone. A deviation from the worktree-first spelling, not its purpose.
- No eval case was added for the added-locale write: the card asks to check the covering evals, and both still hold. A case could be added later at no ratchet cost (eval fixtures are measured, not ratcheted) if the seat wants that behaviour exercised.
- Round 2 (commit 47008cfe) answers triage's contract review of c634c957 (comment 6606375768, FAIL): the must-fix (the change publishes through `@objectstack/skills`, so it carries a patch changeset and the `skip-changeset` label was removed) and the should-fix (the clause lists publish). The should-fix was paid inside the same clause, no re-wrap: "it is" dropped and "email template's row" spelled "email-template row". Nothing else moved.
- Triage's review names two other copies of the close stated without the carve-out, `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` and ADR-0146 § D11; they are outside this card's file surface and go to a follow-up card.
- The `Model:` line above carries no model identifier outside the verbatim ruling quotation (AGENTS.md, commit-message and PR-body rule); the tier names appear only inside the quoted ruling.
